title: Breakfast and Lunch
text:
I eat breakfast at home every morning. My favourite breakfast is bread with cheese. I also drink a cup of tea. Sometimes I eat an egg too.

Lunch is at school at twelve o'clock. I eat rice and chicken with vegetables. My friend Anna eats pasta. We eat together and talk about our day.

questions.text: What is the writer's favourite breakfast?
When does the writer eat lunch?
What can we infer about the writer's lunch?
options: It is a social time with friends

questions.text: Why does the writer eat breakfast at home every morning?
options: Because the food at school is bad
Because the writer has no money
Because it is a regular part of the writer's day
Because breakfast is not served at school

vocabulary.definition: the first meal of the day, eaten in the morning
with another person or other people, not alone
a meal eaten in the middle of the day

paragraph_translations: Jem śniadanie w domu każdego ranka. Moje ulubione śniadanie to chleb z serem. Piję też filiżankę herbaty. Czasami jem też jajko.
Obiad jem w szkole o dwunastej. Jem ryż z kurczakiem i warzywami. Moja przyjaciółka Anna je makaron. Jemy razem i rozmawiamy o naszym dniu.
